heroSub: At Delphi Technologies' spare-parts warehouse in Menderes (Izmir), a warehouse management system (WMS) was implemented to manage warehouse operations.
contextTitle: End-to-end WMS management in spare-parts warehouse
contextP1: At Delphi Technologies' spare-parts warehouse in Menderes (Izmir), a warehouse management system (WMS) was implemented to manage warehouse operations.
contextP2: The project aimed to manage core warehouse processes such as part put-away, customer order picking, and shelf balance in a digital and traceable manner.
problemTitle: Error and inconsistency risk in manual warehouse management
problemLede: Part put-away, order picking, and stock/shelf balance tracking had to be reliable and traceable. Manual flows created high operational risk.

problemList.text: Manual handling increased the risk of placing parts in wrong locations.
Manual customer order picking could lead to fulfillment accuracy issues.
Manual stock and shelf-balance tracking struggled to provide up-to-date reliable data.

solutionTitle: Real-time warehouse operations with WMS and handheld terminals
solutionLede: An end-to-end WMS was deployed for warehouse processes. While part put-away, picking, and shelf-balance operations were managed by the system, field operations were executed in real time via handheld terminal applications and fully recorded.

steps.title: WMS Deployment
steps.text: A central warehouse management system was commissioned to control process flow.

steps.title: Put-away Management
steps.text: Inbound and put-away steps were digitally managed with system rules.

steps.title: Order Picking Operations
steps.text: Customer orders were picked through handheld devices with operational validation.

steps.title: Shelf Balance and Logging
steps.text: Shelf/stock balance movements were tracked in real time and every warehouse move was recorded.

techGrid.title: WMS Application
techGrid.text: Central application layer managing warehouse process rules, locations, and operational flows.

techGrid.title: Handheld Terminal Application
techGrid.text: Mobile operational tool used for put-away, picking, and shelf-balance tasks in the warehouse.

techGrid.title: Real-Time Movement Logging
techGrid.text: Operational tracking structure that records every movement in the warehouse instantly.

integrationTitle: Enterprise synchronization of warehouse data with SAP
integrationDesc: The system operates integrated with SAP; part, order, and stock data are shared with SAP so warehouse movements and shelf balance stay synchronized with the enterprise system and are centrally managed.

integrationList.text: Part and order data are shared bi-directionally with SAP to improve warehouse execution accuracy.
Stock and shelf-balance movements are kept up to date with enterprise systems and centrally controlled.

resultsTitle: Speed, accuracy, and traceability in warehouse operations

resultsGrid.title: Digital and Traceable Processes
resultsGrid.text: Put-away, order picking, and shelf-balance workflows became digital and traceable.

resultsGrid.title: Reduced Error Risk
resultsGrid.text: Risks of wrong placement, incorrect picking, and stock inconsistency were reduced.

resultsGrid.title: Operational Efficiency
resultsGrid.text: Real-time and accurate field execution increased warehouse speed and correctness.
